# CG-RES-015: Response variant removed

A oneOf/anyOf branch was removed from a response schema (or an allOf constraint added).

**Why it matters:** Narrower responses are always handled.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Direction | response |
| Detects | `schema.variantRemoved`, `schema.variantAdded` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> {where} returns fewer {composition} shapes.
>
> Consumers handle a subset of what they handled before.
>
> **Fix:** No action needed.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: variant removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {oneOf: [{type: string}, {type: integer}, {type: boolean}]}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {oneOf: [{type: string}, {type: integer}]}}}}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. GET /x: response 200 (application/json) returns fewer oneOf shapes.

### Does not fire: variant added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {oneOf: [{type: string}, {type: integer}]}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {oneOf: [{type: string}, {type: integer}, {type: boolean}]}}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
